user.title: Sign in to AwoX / EGLO HomeControl
user.description: Sign in once with your AwoX/EGLO HomeControl account. All compatible BLE lights in the account are imported automatically. The account password and cloud session token are not stored.

error.cannot_connect: The AwoX cloud is currently unreachable.
error.no_devices: No compatible BLE lights were found in the AwoX account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while importing the account.

abort.already_configured: This AwoX account is already configured.

data_description.max_concurrent_commands: Maximum number of AwoX lamp commands that may run at the same time for this account (1-32). Higher values require enough Bluetooth connection capacity.
